help.title: Help Center
help.intro: Quick answers for the most common tasks.
help.q1: How do I add my first lead?
help.a1: Go to the Leads page and click Add Lead.
help.q2: How do I use AI to generate content?
help.a2: Open AI Tools, choose Content Generator, then enter a topic.
help.q3: How do I create a funnel page?
help.a3: Go to Funnels and click Create Funnel, then pick a template.
help.q4: What should I do every day?
help.a4: Check Daily Actions and complete the list for the day.
help.q5: How do I follow up with leads?
help.a5: Open a lead detail page and set the follow-up date.
help.q6: How do I invite a new member?
help.a6: Go to Team and click Invite Member.
help.q7: How do I approve new members?
help.a7: Open Approvals in the admin area and review the pending list.
help.q8: How do I change the language?
help.a8: Use the language switcher in the top bar.
help.q9: What happens when AI usage runs out?
help.a9: Contact your administrator to upgrade the plan.
